entries.28e6d99035a58ae6: Based on the philosophy set out by its founder, the company aims to evolve into a 'Life Care Company' that goes beyond being a condom manufacturer. It also states that it will strengthen its business base centered on the healthcare field, enhance brand value in Japan and overseas, use digital technologies, and create new business opportunities. Viewing the present, ahead of the 100th anniversary of its founding, as an opportunity for a 'second founding', it will promote optimization of its business portfolio and investment in growth areas.
